content: Google Event structured data (last updated 2026-09-08): required name, startDate, location (Place with name+PostalAddress). Recommended description, endDate, eventStatus, image (>=720px wide), offers, organizer, performer. Use UTC offsets; date-only startDate allowed when time unknown; don't use 00:00/23:59 placeholders. On cancel keep startDate/location and set EventCancelled; EventRescheduled uses previousStartDate. Markup only on single-event pages, not listing pages. Don't mark business hours/offers as events.
